data.heading: What changes when your enterprise gets Amp'd

blocks.eyebrow: Agivant Bolt, The AI – Native OS
blocks.title: Agivant Bolt
blocks.heading: Every build runs against a specification you own
blocks.body: Agivant Bolt is the AI-Native OS underneath Amp'd, running on a governed harness. The specification is the single source of truth, ahead of the code.

items.title: Spec-first
items.body: The behavior is written down and versioned before the build starts, and everything downstream is generated from it

items.title: One playbook across the build
items.body: Every stage of the AI-native engineering lifecycle runs the same steps, so quality holds across teams and engagements

items.title: The right tool at the right stage
items.body: A build matrix shows an engineer exactly which tools fit each stage of the work

items.title: Change the spec, the build follows
items.body: Engineers update the spec and the build follows, so speed and cost stay predictable

items.title: Governed at runtime, traced to the spec
items.body: Runtime controls set what agents can do, and every action traces back to the specification, giving security and engineering teams a clear record of what changed, why, and which controls applied

blocks.title:
Forward
Deployed Engineers
blocks.heading: Week one is a build week
blocks.body: Forward Deployed Engineers work alongside your teams, inside your environment. One pod brings domain, architecture, AI and data expertise around the same outcome from the start.

items.title: Agent-native from day one
items.body: Engineers arrive ready to work with agentic systems, so the first week moves into the build instead of a long onboarding cycle

items.title: One pod around the problem
items.body: Domain experts, solution architects, AI engineers and data engineers work toward the same outcome

items.title: Real constraints shape the spec
items.body: Data residency and security requirements shape the spec from the start, and core systems set its boundaries

items.title: Set the autonomy line early
items.body: Token budgets, cost tags, spend alerts, and right-sized compute go in with the first pipeline.

items.title: Built for ownership
items.body: The team that builds the system still runs it a year later, and client engineers extend and own it from there

blocks.eyebrow: Production Grade AI Agents and Solutions
blocks.title:
Production Grade
AI Agents
blocks.heading: Every agent is engineered as part of a working system
blocks.body: Harness engineering is what makes an agent safe to run inside an enterprise system. Agivant engineers the surrounding controls first, then widens what the agent is allowed to do as the evidence arrives.

blocks.title:
Every Build
Amplifies
blocks.heading: The next build starts ahead of the last
blocks.body: Each build leaves proven patterns, specifications and assets ready to reuse. The next workflow starts with more context, more evidence and less repeat work.

items.title: A workshop that keeps growing
items.body: Proven tools and patterns from one engagement stay ready for the next

items.title: Proven under real conditions
items.body: Every reusable block comes from work that already runs in production and has cleared enterprise review

items.title: Agents arrive prepared
items.body: Agivant agents draw on proven specifications before they enter a new workflow

items.title: The assets stay with the client
items.body: Everything Agivant builds stays inside the client's own systems, where internal teams extend and reuse it

items.title: Each build reduces repeat work
items.body: As the library grows, teams spend more of their time on new problems and less on rebuilding solved ones

data.heading: Inside the Amp'd build environment
data.subheading: See what changes at every stage of the build
data.description: Agivant Bolt connects business intent, solution specification, agentic build, verification and learning across architecture, engineering, QA and operations. Each stage moves the work forward with the controls, evidence and reusable assets the next stage needs.

media.alt: Inside the Amp'd build environment — interactive build matrix

blocks.title: Harness engineering around every agent
blocks.description: Tool contracts, identity, memory, observability, evaluations and guardrails are engineered around the agent, defining what it can do, what it can access and how its actions are verified

blocks.title: Identity starts with the build
blocks.description: Each agent gets a distinct identity, scoped access and an execution trace, so every action can be attributed and verified

blocks.title: Agents work as a team
blocks.description: Every production-grade agentic solution runs on multi-agent orchestration

blocks.title: Autonomy grows with evidence
blocks.description: Bounded autonomy keeps people involved where judgment matters, then widens the agent's scope as evidence builds

blocks.title: Use the agent or the full solution
blocks.description: An agent runs on its own and moves between solutions. A solution adds the surrounding capability to run a broader business process
